@Gideon Sato, I can't address a draft to Mateo Quiroga at Vantorre yet. He's outside pemberline.com, so the draft needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. I've asked her by DM and will create it once she says yes.

Here is the summary you can check now, from #inc-vtg-hartford:

Subject: Hartford gate kiosks: incident summary (Aug 3)

Hi Mateo,

Here is where the Hartford gate kiosk incident stands.
- Aug 3, 2026, morning: the gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Dispatch scheduling still worked.
- Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03, and trailer 8836 checked in and showed in dispatch.
- Both lanes were working as of 11:07 on Aug 3. We left the incident open for another arrival cycle and kept kiosk 2 powered on for reconnect logs.
- Your status-page access issue is tracked in ticket INC-4821. Your admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see arrivals, so this is the status page only.

Thanks for your patience. Reply here with any issues.

Gideon
